Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production cat animation sprite sheet for a cozy 2D garden game.
Make ONE square RGBA image with true transparent background, exactly 4 equal-width columns and 4 equal-height rows, precisely 16 separate frames read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. No lines, borders, labels, numbers, letters, decoration, or ground plane.
The supplied image is a reference for character identity and visual style only: preserve its adorable plush storybook 3D-render style, breed, markings, proportions, eyes, and soft lighting.
Subject: Ragdoll — fluffy cream body, dark seal-point face ears paws and tail, blue eyes. One consistent individual in all sixteen cells, always viewed from the same slightly elevated three-quarter side angle, facing LEFT; never turn toward a different direction.
Rows 1–2 are an eight-frame WALK CYCLE: contact left front/right back; down/compression; passing; high point; opposite contact; down; passing; high point. Clearly articulate all four legs, subtle shoulder/hip motion and tail follow-through. Never slide the whole character across the frame, never simply duplicate the pose. Keep its torso horizontal and head height mostly steady.
Rows 3–4 are eight EATING frames: alert before eating; head lowering; mouth at bowl taking bite; chewing mouth slightly open; chewing mouth closed; chewing a second small bite; raising chin to swallow eyes gently closing; head lifted after swallow. There must be a visible head lowering/bite/chew/swallow sequence. A small pale terracotta food bowl with kibble stays at exactly the same position to the LEFT of the forepaws in ALL eight eating frames. No bowl in walking frames.
Technical constraints: strict uniform 4x4 lattice, one complete cat per cell. Each cat and bowl fits inside its own cell, with 8 percent transparent padding on all sides. Same body scale, camera, lighting and baseline in every frame. Place torso anchor at the same normalized cell coordinate and paws on a common baseline; no zoom, no random offsets, no cropped ears/tails. Clean alpha edge, no checkerboard painted into the image.
